To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of a topic model for document retrieval can improve the performance of learning-to-rank methods; (2) a unified optimization framework can be used to integrate the discovery of a probabilistic topic model with the learning-to-ranks task.
we propose a unified posterior regularized topic model with maximum margin for learning-to-ranks.

a) we propose a novel learning-to-rank model that integrates the supervised learning with the discovery of the most suitable topic model; b) our model can dynamically compute the topic score between the query document; c) we use a unified optimization framework to compute the latent topic model; and d) we evaluate our model with a large scale dataset and compare our results with state-of-the-art methods, showing a consistent improvement over existing methods.

the problem of learning to rank, i.e. the problem of learning the optimal ranking function for a given query and a set of documents, given the relevance labels of a small set of documents.
